dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: I gather information first by force of habit. But this Domain is constantly shifting, making it difficult to get a holistic view. We should be careful as we progress.

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: Ohohoho, lost your nerve, have you, Kinich? And here I thought you were an adrenaline junkie!

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: The Almighty Dragonlord, K'uhul Ajaw perceives that ahead lies an extremely extreme "challenge" with your name on it! Surely you wouldn't want such a fantastic opportunity to slip through your fingers and into the grasp of another? Hehehehe...
